reason: $24.99 for the first box is about 83 cents a day, which is fair for bisglycinate with a named lab report, and I travel twice a month so pre-counted sachets are handy. I would try one box at the launch price and not stock up.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And is $29.99 after the launch price worth it versus those?
would_change_my_mind: If a competing blend with several magnesium forms were cheaper per day, or if the lab report on the page turned out to be missing or not matching my batch.
